name: Plan Task
purpose: Turn an ambiguous or multi-step task into a short, executable plan before tool use.

name: Extend Skills
purpose: Add or update skills in OPX's own skill collection.

name: OPX Help
purpose: Answer questions about OPX by reading its current source code.

name: Verify Result
purpose: Verify completed work and review it critically before returning it.

name: Code Review
purpose: Review a change for correctness, regressions, maintainability, security and missing tests.

name: Debug
purpose: Find the cause of a defect or incident and apply a minimal fix when requested.

name: Implement Feature
purpose: Implement a requested feature while preserving existing architecture and behavior.

name: Refactor
purpose: Improve structure or maintainability without intentionally changing observable behavior.

name: Understand Codebase
purpose: Find relevant code and build a reliable model of an unfamiliar repository.

name: Write Tests
purpose: Create focused tests that protect important behavior and catch plausible regressions.

name: Architecture Summary
purpose: Produce a concise architecture description based on the actual repository.

name: Document API
purpose: Document an API accurately enough for another developer to integrate without reading the implementation.

name: Write README
purpose: Create or improve repository documentation so a new contributor can understand, run and use the project.

name: Inspect Git History
purpose: Use repository history to understand why code exists, when behavior changed or who introduced it.

name: Compare Alternatives
purpose: Evaluate competing implementation approaches against explicit technical criteria.
